Name: Bold Upscaled Anime Eyes
Author: twilightdvsn
Description:
Gives the farmer higher resolution anime style eyes. Currently only in brown and for the girl farmer.

Requires Scale Up Unofficial and Content Patcher.

This is NOT a Fashion Sense texture pack, other mods that use higher resolution textures to give the player different eyes have a bug where the eyes texture will be offset from the farmer's body when riding a horse. Fashion Sense is still compatible, just not a dependency.

I would like to update this in the future to include other eye colors, and if requested, a version for the guy farmers out there too. This is only in brown and for the girl farmer because I've been using this only for personal use, but I plan on updating this to include all the natural eye colors (brown, blue, green, hazel, amber, gray) and fun colors as well (pink, purple, red).

I hope you guys enjoy and please leave any questions, concerns, or requests in the comments section <3
